notes: Claimed v2 output for fixture_wall. The two parts are picked individually and routed over the top of the y=0.45 obstacle via a high-transit y ≈ 0.65. v2 derives the transit height from the scene's obstacles field; in v1 the caller had to script each transit manually using movePose. The wire steps are the same five types — what changed is which layer owns the routing decision.
